_doc: Repos kept side by side with this workspace. dir defaults to the repo name. push: auto = bin/sync commits and pushes it; manual = never pushed by bin/sync (branch + PR). attach: always = cloned/attached every session; on-demand = only when a task needs it.

repos.purpose: The monolith. JIRA work only, on a branch, through a PR. Personal notes never go here.
Planning docs and scripts for WorkSight tickets.
Team knowledge base. main is protected; every change lands through a PR.
Team epics, per-PR handoffs, ingest inbox.
Wiki projected from gna-brain. Read-only: never author here, change the brain note instead.
